title: NC-PLUS-TICKFAIL-measure-2026-11-13T11: Add metrics retention: prune metrics rows older than 30 days via scheduled tick step
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the backlog item PLUS-TICKFAIL-measure-2026-11-13T11 was parked needs-code by the in-tick doer
**Done check:** cmd:python3 scripts/needs_code_bridge.py --probe PLUS-TICKFAIL-measure-2026-11-13T11
**Status:** closed

Add metrics retention: prune metrics rows older than 30 days via scheduled tick step

Backlog done check: After a scheduled tick, metrics table contains rows for the latest tick and no rows older than 30 days; next tick's measure step succeeds

Triage: Pruning metrics in a scheduled tick requires editing Worker code (D1 queries in the tick handler); the doer can only write the backlog DB, not code. | first step: Open a code task for a developer to add a DELETE FROM metrics WHERE created_at < date('now','-30 days') step in the scheduled tick handler.

Bridged from the backlog by scripts/needs_code_bridge.py (NEEDS-CODE-BRIDGE-1). The change is code, data or a test that a loop consumes; a document alone does not close it.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 26.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
